<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ValidationRule xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <fullName>Apex_Auth_Needs_Class</fullName>
    <active>true</active>
    <description>Enter the Auth Class when Connection Type is Apex Auth.</description>
    <errorConditionFormula>AND(ISPICKVAL(Connection_Type__c, "Apex Auth"), ISBLANK(Auth_Class__c))</errorConditionFormula>
    <errorMessage>Enter the Auth Class when Connection Type is Apex Auth.</errorMessage>
</ValidationRule>
